# Welcome

These practicals use study-level data to compare biosimilar follitropin alfa products with the reference product GONAL-f. They cover two outcomes: **ongoing pregnancy**, a binary outcome summarized with a risk ratio (RR), and **number of oocytes retrieved**, a continuous outcome summarized with a mean difference (MD).

The ongoing-pregnancy practical uses the supplied [`ongoing_pregnancy_deae274.rds` dataset](ongoing_pregnancy_deae274.rds), which contains event counts and denominators for seven study comparisons. The oocyte practical uses the supplied [`number_oocytes_deae274.rds` dataset](number_oocytes_deae274.rds), with sample sizes, means, and standard deviations for six comparisons. Those summaries were transcribed from Figures 2B and 3D in the paper [review PDF](deae274.pdf) (*Human Reproduction*, 2025, 40(2), 343–359). Both datasets contain study-level summaries, not individual participant records.

For ongoing pregnancy, an RR compares the risk in the biosimilar arm with the risk in the GONAL-f arm; RR = 1 is the no-difference value. For oocyte count, the MD is the biosimilar-arm mean minus the GONAL-f mean; MD = 0 is the no-difference value. Keep these outcome scales in mind when comparing results across the practicals.

## Practical materials

Start with Part 1 for the outcome-specific data and study effects, then continue to the pooled analyses. Each practical has a task page and a companion worked solution.

## Getting started

Install [R](https://cran.r-project.org/) and [RStudio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/). The practical pages identify the R packages they use and include code that can be run in RStudio. Keep the relevant dataset in the project directory when running each task.

The practicals accompany the online course [An Introduction to Meta-analysis](https://sdas.thinkific.com/courses/metaanalysisintro).
